waves.name: Baseline / source reconciliation
waves.exit: Pinned GitHub revision, complete source-page coverage and exact requirement inventory
waves.negative_control: Changing Git HEAD or removing a source locator blocks acceptance

waves.name: Young-author private creation
waves.exit: Local draft snapshots and consent-based review contract
waves.negative_control: Rejected revision cannot overwrite any original bytes

waves.name: Cultural epistemic type system
waves.exit: External fact and fictional canon never collapse
waves.negative_control: Invented rite cannot become externally verified

waves.name: Place/time-source precision
waves.exit: Location, festival, school and transit uncertainty retained
waves.negative_control: Unverified last-train clock is not invented

waves.name: Script/romanization/name policy
waves.exit: Kanji ambiguity and lossy ASCII fallback preserved
waves.negative_control: Unknown kanji reading is not silently guessed

waves.name: School/family/daily-life variants
waves.exit: Institution- and family-specific contextual profiles
waves.negative_control: Non-April school is not automatically rejected

waves.name: Sacred/religious sites
waves.exit: Temple/shrine/context-specific source checks
waves.negative_control: Temple cannot inherit mandatory torii choreography

waves.name: Yōkai and folklore variants
waves.exit: Variant genealogy, source links and right types
waves.negative_control: Conflicting local versions coexist without forced canonicalization

waves.name: Ainu/Ryukyuan/source dignity
waves.exit: Community-primary evidence and bounded cultural claims
waves.negative_control: Okinawa customs not overwritten by Kyoto defaults

waves.name: World-scoped Ki-Threads
waves.exit: Legacy technique aliases and optional per-world power rules
waves.negative_control: No-magic novel is not forced to use ranks or power costs

waves.name: Characters and social-register choices
waves.exit: Honorific/relationship shifts and age independence
waves.negative_control: Sarcastic name change not treated as automatic cultural failure

waves.name: Genre lenses, not recipes
waves.exit: Optional slice-of-life/quiet experiment modes
waves.negative_control: No mandatory tournament, 12 episodes, or culture beat quota

waves.name: Novel/manga/audio/game boundaries
waves.exit: Derivative previews preserve source canon references
waves.negative_control: Audio/manga export alone cannot write to canon

waves.name: Writer Desk modes and questions
waves.exit: Critique, question-only and proposal contracts
waves.negative_control: Questions-only cannot silently ghostwrite a scene

waves.name: Source-aware local research index
waves.exit: Attributable source cards, denied tool instructions
waves.negative_control: Malicious retrieved wiki cannot trigger manuscript upload

waves.name: Provenance/licensing permissions
waves.exit: Rights-aware source snippets and unadopted seed cards
waves.negative_control: Copyright excerpt excluded from publish-ready package

waves.name: Legacy Japan v1 migration
waves.exit: Old CID/CHAR/TECH/NAME/LOC IDs preserve original bytes
waves.negative_control: Ambiguous/duplicate ID cannot silently overwrite

waves.name: Adversarial cultural QA
waves.exit: Named positive & negative variation fixtures pass locally
waves.negative_control: False nationwide generalizations are not accepted

waves.name: Human calibration and real writer feedback
waves.exit: Attributed author/reader reports with explicit unverified states
waves.negative_control: Automated aesthetic grade never labeled reader-verified

waves.name: Canonical merge and release proof
waves.exit: Upstream v4-v7 regression, exact authority, independent receipts
waves.negative_control: Local test pass never upgrades upstream wave to shipped
